Explore the Electron desktop app at /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W. I need a thorough understanding of the main process, contract/IPC, and preload layers.

Focus on these directories:
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/main (including browser/, managed-process/, toolchains/ and probes/)
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/contract
- /tmp/openwiki-bench-u82Z3W/src/preload

For each, report:
1. Responsibilities and architecture/ownership
2. Key entrypoints and control/data flows
3. IPC contract design (typed MessagePort RPC), methods/handlers, revisioning
4. Main-owned WebContentsView browser system: how remote pages, profiles, network policy work
5. Agent Host supervision and crash reaper
6. Toolchain discovery/probes
7. Any security/security-relevant mechanisms (CSP, sandbox, typed IPC)
8. Representative components: window lifecycle, tray, menu, notifications, single-instance, protocol, auto-update

List the concrete file paths and important symbols (function/class names) for each. Give bounded evidence spans like src/main/foo.ts#L20-L48 where relevant. Report concisely but comprehensively. Do NOT write any files.
I'll explore the Electron desktop app thoroughly. Let me start by understanding the overall structure.

1: /**
2:  * Lightweight MessagePort RPC (no external framework).
3:  * Five message kinds: request / response / subscribe / unsubscribe / event.
4:  * Protocol spec: docs/rpc-protocol.md
5:  */
6: 
7: import type { ApiMethod, ApiParams, ApiResult, StreamTopic, Streams } from "./api";
8: import { RpcError, type RpcErrorShape } from "./types.ts";
9: import { ToolchainError } from "../shared/toolchains/errors.ts";
10: 
11: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
12: // Wire protocol
13: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
14: 
15: export type WireRequest = {
16:   kind: "request";
17:   id: string;
18:   method: string;
19:   params: unknown;
20: };
21: 
22: export type WireResponse = {
23:   kind: "response";
24:   id: string;
25:   ok: boolean;
26:   result?: unknown;
27:   error?: RpcErrorShape;
28: };
29: 
30: export type WireEvent = {
31:   kind: "event";
32:   topic: string;
33:   key: string;
34:   data: unknown;
35: };
36: 
37: export type WireSubscribe = {
38:   kind: "subscribe";
39:   id: string;
40:   topic: string;
41:   key: string;
42: };
43: 
44: export type WireUnsubscribe = {
45:   kind: "unsubscribe";
46:   id: string;
47:   topic: string;
48:   key: string;
49: };
50: 
51: export type WireMessage = WireRequest | WireResponse | WireEvent | WireSubscribe | WireUnsubscribe;
52: 
53: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54: // Client (renderer / any consumer)
55: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
56: 
57: export interface PiRpc {
58:   call<M extends ApiMethod>(
59:     method: M,
60:     ...args: ApiParams<M> extends void ? [] | [void] : [ApiParams<M>]
61:   ): Promise<ApiResult<M>>;
62:   subscribe<T extends StreamTopic>(topic: T, key: string, on: (ev: Streams[T]) => void): () => void;
63:   close(): void;
64: }
65: 
66: type Pending = {
67:   resolve: (v: unknown) => void;
68:   reject: (e: Error) => void;
69:   timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
70: };
71: 
72: type SubEntry = {
73:   topic: string;
74:   key: string;
75:   handler: (ev: unknown) => void;
76: };
77: 
78: let nextId = 0;
79: function makeId(): string {
80:   nextId += 1;
81:   return `r${nextId}_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
82: }
83: 
84: export type RpcClientOptions = {
85:   callTimeoutMs?: number;
86: };
87: 
88: const DEFAULT_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
89: 
90: type RpcClientPort = {
91:   addEventListener(type: "message", listener: (event: MessageEvent) => void): void;
92:   addEventListener(type: "close", listener: () => void): void;
93:   removeEventListener(type: "message", listener: (event: MessageEvent) => void): void;
94:   removeEventListener(type: "close", listener: () => void): void;
95:   postMessage(message: unknown): void;
96:   start(): void;
97:   close(): void;
98: };
99: 
100: export function createRpcClient(port: RpcClientPort, options: RpcClientOptions = {}): PiRpc {
101:   const pending = new Map<string, Pending>();
102:   const subs = new Map<string, SubEntry>();
103:   const configuredTimeout = options.callTimeoutMs;
104:   const callTimeoutMs =
105:     typeof configuredTimeout === "number" && Number.isFinite(configuredTimeout) && configuredTimeout > 0
106:       ? configuredTimeout
107:       : DEFAULT_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS;
108: 
109:   const rejectPending = (shape: RpcErrorShape) => {
110:     for (const [, entry] of pending) {
111:       clearTimeout(entry.timer);
112:       entry.reject(new RpcError(shape));
113:     }
114:     pending.clear();
115:   };
116: 
117:   const onMessage = (ev: MessageEvent) => {
118:     const msg = ev.data as WireMessage;
119:     if (!msg || typeof msg !== "object") return;
120: 
121:     if (msg.kind === "response") {
122:       const p = pending.get(msg.id);
123:       if (!p) return;
124:       pending.delete(msg.id);
125:       clearTimeout(p.timer);
126:       if (msg.ok) p.resolve(msg.result);
127:       else {
128:         p.reject(new RpcError(msg.error ?? { code: "UNKNOWN", message: "Unknown RPC error" }));
129:       }
130:       return;
131:     }
132: 
133:     if (msg.kind === "event") {
134:       for (const sub of subs.values()) {
135:         if (sub.topic === msg.topic && (sub.key === "*" || sub.key === msg.key || msg.key === "*")) {
136:           try {
137:             sub.handler(msg.data);
138:           } catch {
139:             /* ignore subscriber errors */
140:           }
141:         }
142:       }
143:     }
144:   };
145: 
146:   const onClose = () => {
147:     rejectPending({ code: "CLOSED", message: "RPC port closed" });
148:     subs.clear();
149:   };
150: 
151:   port.addEventListener("message", onMessage);
152:   port.addEventListener("close", onClose);
153:   port.start();
154: 
155:   return {
156:     call(method, ...args) {
157:       const params = (args[0] ?? undefined) as unknown;
158:       const id = makeId();
159:       return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
160:         const timer = setTimeout(() => {
161:           if (!pending.delete(id)) return;
162:           reject(new RpcError({ code: "TIMEOUT", message: `RPC call timed out: ${String(method)}` }));
163:         }, callTimeoutMs);
164:         pending.set(id, {
165:           resolve: resolve as (v: unknown) => void,
166:           reject,
167:           timer,
168:         });
169:         const req: WireRequest = {
170:           kind: "request",
171:           id,
172:           method: method as string,
173:           params,
174:         };
175:         try {
176:           port.postMessage(req);
177:         } catch (err) {
178:           pending.delete(id);
179:           clearTimeout(timer);
180:           reject(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)));
181:         }
182:       });
183:     },
184: 
185:     subscribe(topic, key, on) {
186:       const id = makeId();
187:       const msg: WireSubscribe = {
188:         kind: "subscribe",
189:         id,
190:         topic: topic as string,
191:         key,
192:       };
193:       port.postMessage(msg);
194:       subs.set(id, {
195:         topic: topic as string,
196:         key,
197:         handler: on as (ev: unknown) => void,
198:       });
199:       return () => {
200:         subs.delete(id);
201:         const unsub: WireUnsubscribe = {
202:           kind: "unsubscribe",
203:           id,
204:           topic: topic as string,
205:           key,
206:         };
207:         try {
208:           port.postMessage(unsub);
209:         } catch {
210:           /* ignore */
211:         }
212:       };
213:     },
214: 
215:     close() {
216:       port.removeEventListener("message", onMessage);
217:       port.removeEventListener("close", onClose);
218:       rejectPending({ code: "CLOSED", message: "RPC port closed" });
219:       subs.clear();
220:       try {
221:         port.close();
222:       } catch {
223:         /* ignore */
224:       }
225:     },
226:   };
227: }
228: 
229: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
230: // Server (agent-host)
231: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
232: 
233: export type RpcRequestContext = {
234:   setLease(key: string, release: () => void): void;
235:   releaseLease(key: string): boolean;
236: };
237: 
238: export type ApiHandler = {
239:   [M in ApiMethod]?: (params: ApiParams<M>, context: RpcRequestContext) => Promise<ApiResult<M>> | ApiResult<M>;
240: };
241: 
242: export type StreamSink = {
243:   topic: string;
244:   key: string;
245:   emit: (data: unknown) => void;
246: };
247: 
248: /**
249:  * Port shape that works in both:
250:  * - Renderer DOM MessagePort (addEventListener + MessageEvent.data)
251:  * - utilityProcess / Node worker_threads MessagePort (EventEmitter .on('message'))
252:  * - Electron MessagePortMain (.on('message', (e) => e.data))
253:  */
254: export type AnyMessagePort = {
255:   postMessage: (message: unknown, transfer?: unknown[]) => void;
256:   start?: () => void;
257:   close?: () => void;
258:   addEventListener?: (type: string, listener: (ev: { data: unknown }) => void) => void;
259:   removeEventListener?: (type: string, listener: (ev: { data: unknown }) => void) => void;
260:   on?: (event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => void;
261:   off?: (event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => void;
262:   removeListener?: (event: string, listener: (...args: unknown[]) => void) => void;
263: };
264: 
265: export interface RpcServer {
266:   handle(handlers: ApiHandler): void;
267:   emit<T extends StreamTopic>(topic: T, key: string, data: Streams[T]): void;
268:   attachPort(port: AnyMessagePort): void;
269:   detachPort(port: AnyMessagePort): void;
270: }
271: 
272: function extractMessageData(arg: unknown): unknown {
273:   // DOM MessageEvent / Electron MessagePortMain event: { data }
274:   if (arg && typeof arg === "object" && "data" in arg && !("kind" in arg)) {
275:     return (arg as { data: unknown }).data;
276:   }
277:   // Node worker_threads MessagePort: payload is the value itself
278:   return arg;
279: }
280: 
281: function listenPort(port: AnyMessagePort, onData: (data: unknown) => void): () => void {
282:   if (typeof port.addEventListener === "function") {
283:     const listener = (ev: { data: unknown }) => onData(ev.data);
284:     port.addEventListener("message", listener);
285:     port.start?.();
286:     return () => port.removeEventListener?.("message", listener);
287:   }
288: 
289:   if (typeof port.on === "function") {
290:     const listener = (...args: unknown[]) => {
291:       onData(extractMessageData(args[0]));
292:     };
293:     port.on("message", listener);
294:     port.start?.();
295:     return () => {
296:       port.off?.("message", listener);
297:       port.removeListener?.("message", listener);
298:     };
299:   }
300: 
301:   throw new Error("MessagePort has neither addEventListener nor on()");
302: }
303: 
304: export function createRpcServer(): RpcServer {
305:   const handlers = new Map<string, (params: unknown, context: RpcRequestContext) => Promise<unknown> | unknown>();
306:   const ports = new Set<AnyMessagePort>();
307:   /** port → subscription id → { topic, key } */
308:   const portSubs = new Map<AnyMessagePort, Map<string, { topic: string; key: string }>>();
309:   const portUnlisten = new Map<AnyMessagePort, () => void>();
310:   const portCloseUnlisten = new Map<AnyMessagePort, () => void>();
311:   const portLeases = new Map<AnyMessagePort, Map<string, () => void>>();
312: 
313:   function forgetPort(port: AnyMessagePort): void {
314:     ports.delete(port);
315:     portSubs.delete(port);
316:     const leases = portLeases.get(port);
317:     portLeases.delete(port);
318:     for (const release of leases?.values() ?? []) {
319:       try {
320:         release();
321:       } catch {
322:         /* isolate resource finalizers */
323:       }
324:     }
325:     portUnlisten.get(port)?.();
326:     portUnlisten.delete(port);
327:     portCloseUnlisten.get(port)?.();
328:     portCloseUnlisten.delete(port);
329:   }
330: 
331:   function requestContext(port: AnyMessagePort): RpcRequestContext {
332:     return {
333:       setLease(key, release) {
334:         if (!ports.has(port)) {
335:           release();
336:           return;
337:         }
338:         const leases = portLeases.get(port) ?? new Map<string, () => void>();
339:         const previous = leases.get(key);
340:         leases.set(key, release);
341:         portLeases.set(port, leases);
342:         if (previous && previous !== release) previous();
343:       },
344:       releaseLease(key) {
345:         const leases = portLeases.get(port);
346:         const release = leases?.get(key);
347:         if (!release) return false;
348:         leases?.delete(key);
349:         try {
350:           release();
351:         } catch {
352:           /* isolate explicit resource release */
353:         }
354:         return true;
355:       },
356:     };
357:   }
358: 
359:   function ensureSubs(port: AnyMessagePort): Map<string, { topic: string; key: string }> {
360:     let m = portSubs.get(port);
361:     if (!m) {
362:       m = new Map();
363:       portSubs.set(port, m);
364:     }
365:     return m;
366:   }
367: 
368:   async function onPortMessage(port: AnyMessagePort, raw: unknown) {
369:     const msg = raw as WireMessage;
370:     if (!msg || typeof msg !== "object") return;
371: 
372:     if (msg.kind === "subscribe") {
373:       ensureSubs(port).set(msg.id, { topic: msg.topic, key: msg.key });
374:       return;
375:     }
376:     if (msg.kind === "unsubscribe") {
377:       ensureSubs(port).delete(msg.id);
378:       return;
379:     }
380:     if (msg.kind !== "request") return;
381: 
382:     const handler = handlers.get(msg.method);
383: 
384:     let response: WireResponse;
385:     try {
386:       if (!handler) {
387:         throw new RpcError({
388:           code: "METHOD_NOT_FOUND",
389:           message: `Unknown method: ${msg.method}`,
390:         });
391:       }
392:       const result = await handler(msg.params, requestContext(port));
393:       response = { kind: "response", id: msg.id, ok: true, result };
394:     } catch (err) {
395:       const error: RpcErrorShape =
396:         err instanceof RpcError
397:           ? { code: err.code, message: err.message, detail: err.detail }
398:           : err instanceof ToolchainError
399:             ? {
400:                 code: err.code,
401:                 message: err.message,
402:                 detail: { capability: err.capability, causeCode: err.causeCode },
403:               }
404:             : {
405:                 code: "INTERNAL",
406:                 message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),
407:               };
408:       response = { kind: "response", id: msg.id, ok: false, error };
409:     }
410:     try {
411:       port.postMessage(response);
412:     } catch {
413:       const fallback: WireResponse = {
414:         kind: "response",
415:         id: msg.id,
416:         ok: false,
417:         error: { code: "SERIALIZATION_FAILED", message: "RPC response could not be serialized" },
418:       };
419:       try {
420:         port.postMessage(fallback);
421:       } catch {
422:         forgetPort(port);
423:         try {
424:           port.close?.();
425:         } catch {
426:           /* ignore a transport that is already closed */
427:         }
428:       }
429:     }
430:   }
431: 
432:   return {
433:     handle(next) {
434:       for (const [method, handler] of Object.entries(next)) {
435:         if (typeof handler === "function")

463:             port.close?.();
464:           } catch {

466:           }
467:         }
468:       }
469:     },

614:   private configureSession(profile: BrowserProfileInfo, browserSession: Session): void {
615:     browserSession.setDevicePermissionHandler(() => false);
616:     if (profile.mode === "unsafe") {
617:       browserSession.setCertificateVerifyProc((request, callback) => {
618:         const advanced = this.policy.getAdvancedRuntimePolicy();
619:         callback(
620:           advanced.enabled && advanced.certificateBypassDomains.includes(request.hostname.trim().toLowerCase())
621:             ? 0
622:             : request.errorCode,
623:         );
624:       });
625:     }
626:     const interceptor = new BrowserNetworkInterceptor({
627:       session: browserSession,
628:       profileId: profile.id,
629:       getNavigationSettings: () => this.policy.getSettings().navigation,
630:       getAdvancedRuntimePolicy: () =>
631:         profile.mode === "unsafe" ? this.policy.getAdvancedRuntimePolicy() : createDisabledAdvancedRuntimePolicy(),
632:       getTabForWebContents: (id) => this.tabs.getTabForWebContents(id),
633:       getIdentityForWebContents: (id) => this.tabs.getIdentityForWebContents(id),
634:       resolveSecret: (ref) => this.secrets.get(ref),
635:       emit: (event) => this.emit(event),
636:       onBlockedRequest: (url, code) => {
637:         if (code === "UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL" && /^mailto:/i.test(url)) {
638:           void this.openExternalWithConfirmation(url).catch(() => undefined);
639:         }
640:       },
641:     });
642:     this.interceptors.set(profile.id, interceptor);
643:     this.applyStoredHeaderRules(profile.id, interceptor);
644: 
645:     const downloadManager = new BrowserDownloadManager({
646:       session: browserSession,
647:       getSettings: () => this.policy.getSettings().downloads,
648:       getTabForWebContents: (id) => this.tabs.getTabForWebContents(id),
649:       chooseSavePath: (filename) => this.options.chooseSavePath?.(filename) ?? this.defaultChooseSavePath(filename),
650:       emit: (event) => this.emit(event),
651:     });
652:     this.downloads.set(profile.id, downloadManager);
653:     const proxy = this.policy.getSettings().proxy;
654:     const proxyOptions =
655:       proxy.mode === "custom"
656:         ? {
657:             mode: "fixed_servers" as const,
658:             proxyRules: proxy.proxyRules,
659:             ...(proxy.proxyBypassRules ? { proxyBypassRules: proxy.proxyBypassRules } : {}),
660:           }
661:         : { mode: proxy.mode };
662:     void browserSession.setProxy(proxyOptions).catch(() => undefined);
663:   }

668:     interceptor.setResponseRules(this.combinedHeaderRules(profileId, "response"));

671:   private applySettingsSideEffects(before: ReturnType<BrowserPolicyEngine["getSettings"]>, after: typeof before): void {
672:     if (

674:       JSON.stringify(before.advancedBrowserMode) !== JSON.stringify(after.advancedBrowserMode)
675:     ) {
676:       this.tabs.revokeAgentActions();
677:     }

679:     if (!after.automation.enabled) this.tabs.revokeAgentActions();
680:     if (!this.policy.isAdvancedEnabled()) {

685:     } else {

687:         this.applyStoredHeaderRules(profileId, interceptor);

689:       void this.tabs.applyAdvancedMode().catch(() => undefined);
690:     }
691:     if (
692:       before.proxy.mode !== after.proxy.mode ||
693:       before.proxy.proxyRules !== after.proxy.proxyRules ||
694:       before.proxy.proxyBypassRules !== after.proxy.proxyBypassRules
695:     ) {
696:       for (const profile of this.profiles.list()) void this.applyProxy(profile.id).catch(() => undefined);
697:     }
698:     if (!after.panel.restoreTabs) this.restoreStore.clear();
699:   }

705:   private async dispatchHostRequest<M extends BrowserHostMethod>(
706:     method: M,
707:     params: BrowserHostParams<M>,
708:   ): Promise<BrowserHostResult<M>> {
709:     if (!params || typeof params !== "object") {
710:       throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser Host request parameters are invalid");
711:     }
712:     if (method === "browser.capabilities") {
713:       const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.capabilities">;
714:       let lease = this.policy.getLeaseForSession(body.sessionId);
715:       if (!lease) {
716:         try {
717:           lease = this.policy.issueLease(body.sessionId);
718:         } catch {
719:           // A capability query is allowed to report no grant.
720:         }
721:       }
722:       return { snapshot: this.policy.getSnapshot(), ...(lease ? { lease } : {}) } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
723:     }
724:     if (method === "browser.requestAuthorization") {
725:       const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.requestAuthorization">;
726:       if (
727:         !isBrowserHostMethod(body.targetMethod) ||
728:         body.targetMethod === "browser.capabilities" ||
729:         body.targetMethod === "browser.requestAuthorization" ||
730:         body.targetMethod === "browser.sessionEnded" ||
731:         body.targetMethod === "browser.requestRouteBypass" ||
732:         typeof body.requestId !== "string" ||
733:         !body.requestId ||
734:         body.requestId.length > 256 ||
735:         /[\0\r\n]/.test(body.requestId) ||
736:         (body.source !== "local" && body.source !== "channel")
737:       ) {
738:         throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser authorization preflight is invalid");
739:       }
740:       const minimumPermission = requiredPermission(body.targetMethod);
741:       const currentSettings = this.policy.getSettings();
742:       if (body.source === "channel" && !currentSettings.automation.allowChannelSessions) {
743:         throw new BrowserError("CAPABILITY_DISABLED", "Browser access for channel sessions is disabled");
744:       }
745:       await this.authorization.request(body.sessionId, body.source, minimumPermission);
746:       return {
747:         snapshot: this.policy.getSnapshot(),
748:         lease: this.policy.issueLease(body.sessionId),
749:       } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
750:     }
751:     if (method === "browser.sessionEnded") {
752:       const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.sessionEnded">;
753:       this.revokeSession(body.sessionId);
754:       this.tabs.clearSessionState(body.sessionId);
755:       this.persistentGrants.delete(body.sessionId);
756:       return { ok: true } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
757:     }
758:     if (method === "browser.requestRouteBypass") {
759:       const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.requestRouteBypass">;
760:       if (
761:         typeof body.sessionId !== "string" ||
762:         !body.sessionId ||
763:         body.sessionId.length > 256 ||
764:         typeof body.requestId !== "string" ||
765:         !body.requestId ||
766:         body.requestId.length > 256 ||
767:         !["browser-policy-denied", "browser-unsupported-route"].includes(body.ruleId)
768:       ) {
769:         throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser route bypass request is invalid");
770:       }
771:       let origin: string;
772:       try {
773:         const parsed = new URL(body.origin);
774:         if ((parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") || parsed.origin !== body.origin) {
775:           throw new Error("origin required");
776:         }
777:         origin = parsed.origin;
778:       } catch {
779:         throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser route bypass origin is invalid");
780:       }
781:       const allowed = await (this.options.confirmRouteBypass?.(origin, body.ruleId) ??
782:         this.defaultConfirmRouteBypass(origin));
783:       return { allowed } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
784:     }
785:     const context = params as BrowserHostParams<
786:       Exclude<
787:         M,
788:         "browser.capabilities" | "browser.requestAuthorization" | "browser.sessionEnded" | "browser.requestRouteBypass"
789:       >
790:     >;
791:     const permission = requiredPermission(method);
792:     this.policy.assertRequest(context, permission);
793: 
794:     switch (method) {
795:       case "browser.open": {
796:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.open">;
797:         const tab = await this.tabs.create({
798:           url: body.url,
799:           profileId: body.profileId,
800:           activate: body.activate,
801:           ownerSessionId: body.sessionId,
802:         });
803:         return {
804:           ...tab,
805:           siteSnippetCount: this.policy.isAdvancedEnabled() ? this.snippetStore.listForUrl(tab.url).siteCount : 0,
806:         } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
807:       }
808:       case "browser.listTabs":
809:         return { tabs: this.tabs.list(context.sessionId) } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
810:       case "browser.navigate": {
811:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.navigate">;
812:         return (await this.tabs.navigate(body.tabId, body.url, body.sessionId)) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
813:       }
814:       case "browser.snapshot": {
815:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.snapshot">;
816:         return (await this.tabs.snapshot(body.tabId, body.sessionId, body)) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
817:       }
818:       case "browser.inspect": {
819:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.inspect">;
820:         return (await this.tabs.inspect(body.sessionId, body)) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
821:       }
822:       case "browser.screenshot": {
823:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.screenshot">;
824:         return (await this.tabs.screenshot(body.tabId, body.sessionId, body)) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
825:       }
826:       case "browser.click": {
827:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.click">;
828:         return (await this.tabs.click(
829:           body.tabId,
830:           body.sessionId,
831:           body.ref,
832:           body.snapshotId,
833:           body.generation,
834:           body.button,
835:           body.clickCount,
836:           body.modifiers,
837:         )) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
838:       }
839:       case "browser.clickAt": {
840:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.clickAt">;
841:         return (await this.tabs.clickAt(
842:           body.tabId,
843:           body.sessionId,
844:           body.x,
845:           body.y,
846:           body.button,
847:           body.clickCount,
848:           body.modifiers,
849:         )) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
850:       }
851:       case "browser.type": {
852:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.type">;
853:         const inputPath = await this.tabs.type(
854:           body.tabId,
855:           body.sessionId,
856:           body.ref,
857:           body.snapshotId,
858:           body.generation,
859:           body.text,
860:           body.submit,
861:         );
862:         return { ok: true, inputPath } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
863:       }
864:       case "browser.press": {
865:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.press">;
866:         await this.tabs.press(body.tabId, body.sessionId, body.key, body.modifiers);
867:         return { ok: true } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
868:       }
869:       case "browser.scroll": {
870:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.scroll">;
871:         await this.tabs.scroll(body.tabId, body.sessionId, body);
872:         return { ok: true } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
873:       }
874:       case "browser.wait": {
875:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.wait">;
876:         const elapsedMs = await this.tabs.wait(body.tabId, body.sessionId, body);
877:         return { ok: true, elapsedMs } as BrowserHostResult<M>;
878:       }
879:       case "browser.back": {
880:         const body = params as BrowserHostParams<"browser.back">;
881:         return (await this.tabs.goBack(body.tabId, body.sessionId)) as BrowserHostResult<M>;
882:       }

379:     return value.replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/gi, "").slice(-12);

391:       throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser surface bounds are invalid");
392:     }
393:     const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.round(rect.x), Math.max(0, content.width - 1)));
394:     const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.round(rect.y), Math.max(0, content.height - 1)));
395:     const width = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.round(rect.width), content.width - x));
396:     const height = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.round(rect.height), content.height - y));
397:     record.bounds = { x, y, width, height };
398:     // Hidden owned tabs still need a real surface size for screenshots and
399:     // visual comparisons. setVisible(false) prevents presentation over the UI.
400:     record.view.setBounds(record.bounds);
401:   }

403:   async navigate(
404:     tabId: string,
405:     rawUrl: string,
406:     sessionId?: string,
407:     userInitiated = false,
408:     navigationOptions?: Electron.LoadURLOptions,
409:   ): Promise<BrowserTabInfo> {
410:     const record = this.requireOwnedTab(tabId, sessionId);
411:     const url = normalizeAddress(rawUrl);
412:     const policy = this.getNetworkPolicy(record);
413:     const checked = await policy.check(url, {
414:       settings: this.options.getSettings().navigation,
415:       allowAboutBlank: true,
416:       userApprovedPrivateNetwork: userInitiated,
417:     });
418:     if (checked.privateNetwork && !this.options.getSettings().navigation.allowPrivateNetwork) {
419:       if (!userInitiated) {
420:         throw new BrowserError("PRIVATE_NETWORK_BLOCKED", "Agent navigation to a private network target is blocked");
421:       }
422:       const origin = new URL(checked.url).origin;
423:       const approvalKey = `${record.info.profileId}\0${origin}`;
424:       if (!this.locallyApprovedPrivateOrigins.has(approvalKey)) {
425:         const approved = await (this.options.confirmPrivateNetwork?.(checked.url) ?? Promise.resolve(false));
426:         if (!approved) throw new BrowserError("PRIVATE_NETWORK_BLOCKED", "Private network navigation was not approved");
427:         this.locallyApprovedPrivateOrigins.add(approvalKey);
428:       }
429:       this.options.approvePrivateOrigin?.(record.info.profileId, origin);
430:     }
431:     await record.advancedReady;
432:     record.networkRecorder?.armBodyCapture();
433:     try {
434:       await this.runAction(record, sessionId, "read", async (signal) => {
435:         await withTimeout(
436:           record.view.webContents.loadURL(checked.url, navigationOptions),
437:           this.options.getSettings().navigation.navigationTimeoutMs,
438:           "ACTION_TIMEOUT",
439:           signal,
440:         );
441:       });
442:       if (record.lastLoadFailure) throw navigationFailureError(record.lastLoadFailure);
443:     } catch (error) {
444:       if (
445:         error instanceof BrowserError &&
446:         error.code !== "ACTION_TIMEOUT" &&
447:         error.code !== "INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST"
448:       ) {
449:         throw error;
450:       }
451:       throw navigationFailureError(error);
452:     }
453:     return structuredClone(record.info);
454:   }

494:   async inspect(
495:     sessionId: string,
496:     input: {
497:       tabId?: string;
498:       sinceInspectionId?: string;
499:       maxNodes?: number;
500:       maxTextChars?: number;
501:       screenshot?: { enabled: boolean; format?: "png" | "jpeg"; quality?: number };
502:     } = {},
503:   ): Promise<BrowserInspectResult> {
504:     const record = this.resolveInspectionTab(input.tabId, sessionId);
505:     const maxNodes = clampInteger(input.maxNodes ?? DEFAULT_INSPECTION_MAX_NODES, 1, 1_000);
506:     const maxTextChars = clampInteger(input.maxTextChars ?? DEFAULT_INSPECTION_MAX_TEXT_CHARS, 250, 60_000);
507:     const nodeCharBudget = input.maxNodes === undefined ? DEFAULT_INSPECTION_NODE_CHARS : MAX_INSPECTION_NODE_CHARS;
508:     const screenshotEnabled = input.screenshot?.enabled === true;
509:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt += 1) {
510:       try {
511:         return await this.runAction(record, sessionId, "read", async (signal) => {
512:           const startGeneration = record.info.generation;
513:           const captured = await this.captureSnapshot(record, maxNodes, maxTextChars, signal);
514:           const bounded = boundInspectionSnapshot(record, captured.snapshot, nodeCharBudget);
515:           const snapshot = bounded.snapshot;
516:           let screenshot: BrowserScreenshotResult | undefined;
517:           let screenshotUnavailable = false;
518:           if (screenshotEnabled) {
519:             try {
520:               screenshot = await this.captureScreenshot(record, {
521:                 mode: "viewport",
522:                 format: input.screenshot?.format ?? "jpeg",
523:                 quality: input.screenshot?.quality ?? 70,
524:               });
525:             } catch (error) {
526:               if (
527:                 error instanceof BrowserError &&
528:                 ["INSPECTION_STALE", "TAB_NOT_FOUND", "TAB_NOT_OWNED", "TAB_CRASHED"].includes(error.code)
529:               ) {
530:                 throw error;
531:               }
532:               screenshotUnavailable = true;
533:             }
534:           }
535:           if (record.info.generation !== startGeneration || snapshot.generation !== startGeneration) {
536:             throw new BrowserError("INSPECTION_STALE", "Browser page changed during inspection", {
537:               details: { reason: "generation-changed" },
538:             });
539:           }
540:           const screenshotBytes = screenshot ? Buffer.byteLength(screenshot.base64, "base64") : 0;
541:           const screenshotTruncated = screenshotBytes > MAX_INSPECTION_SCREENSHOT_BYTES;
542:           const contentHash = createHash("sha256")
543:             .update(
544:               JSON.stringify({
545:                 generation: startGeneration,
546:                 url: snapshot.url,
547:                 title: snapshot.title,
548:                 loading: record.info.loading,
549:                 text: snapshot.text,
550:                 nodes: snapshot.nodes,
551:               }),
552:             )
553:             .digest("hex");
554:           const viewportHash = screenshot
555:             ? createHash("sha256").update(screenshot.base64).digest("hex")
556:             : "screenshot-disabled";
557:           const state = this.inspections.record({
558:             sessionId,
559:             tabId: record.info.id,
560:             generation: startGeneration,
561:             contentHash,
562:             viewportHash,
563:             sinceInspectionId: input.sinceInspectionId,
564:           });
565:           const ownedTabs = this.list(sessionId);
566:           const tabs = ownedTabs.slice(0, 20).map(tabSummary);
567:           return {
568:             inspectionId: state.inspectionId,
569:             tabId: record.info.id,
570:             generation: startGeneration,
571:             tabs,
572:             url: redactBrowserUrl(record.info.url),
573:             title: record.info.title.slice(0, 512),
574:             loading: record.info.loading,
575:             changed: state.changed,
576:             ...(state.changed ? { snapshot } : {}),
577:             ...(state.changed && screenshot && !screenshotTruncated ? { screenshot } : {}),
578:             truncated: {
579:               text: captured.truncated.text,
580:               nodes: captured.truncated.nodes || bounded.nodesTruncated,
581:               screenshot: screenshotTruncated || screenshotUnavailable,
582:               tabs: ownedTabs.length > tabs.length,
583:             },
584:             untrustedWebContent: true,
585:           };
586:         });
587:       } catch (error) {
588:         if (
589:           !(error instanceof BrowserError) ||
590:           error.code !== "INSPECTION_STALE" ||
591:           error.details?.reason !== "generation-changed" ||
592:           attempt > 0
593:         ) {
594:           throw error;
595:         }
596:       }
597:     }
598:     throw new BrowserError("INSPECTION_STALE", "Browser page changed during inspection");
599:   }

610:   private async captureSnapshot(
611:     record: TabRecord,
612:     maxNodes: number,
613:     maxTextChars: number,
614:     signal: AbortSignal,
615:   ): Promise<CapturedSnapshot> {
616:     record.pendingFileUpload = undefined;
617:     const snapshotId = randomUUID();
618:     const generation = record.info.generation;
619:     const contexts = await collectFrameContexts(record.view.webContents);
620:     const nodes: BrowserSnapshotNode[] = [];
621:     const textParts: string[] = [];
622:     const frameRefs = new Map<string, { frame: WebFrameMain; offsetX: number; offsetY: number }>();
623:     let textLength = 0;
624:     let textTruncated = false;
625:     let nodesTruncated = false;
626:     for (const [frameIndex, context] of contexts.entries()) {
627:       if (nodes.length >= maxNodes || textLength >= maxTextChars) {
628:         // At least this frame remains unread, so either limit may have hidden
629:         // additional page text or interactive nodes.
630:         nodesTruncated = true;
631:         textTruncated = true;
632:         break;
633:       }
634:       const remainingNodes = maxNodes - nodes.length;
635:       const remainingText = maxTextChars - textLength;
636:       let result: unknown;
637:       try {
638:         result = await withTimeout(
639:           context.frame.executeJavaScript(
640:             createSnapshotScript(snapshotId, remainingNodes, remainingText, nodes.length),
641:           ),
642:           this.options.getSettings().navigation.actionTimeoutMs,
643:           "ACTION_TIMEOUT",
644:           signal,
645:         );
646:       } catch {
647:         continue;
648:       }
649:       const parsed = validateSnapshotResult(result);
650:       const frameId = `f${frameIndex}`;
651:       for (const node of parsed.nodes) {
652:         const adjusted: BrowserSnapshotNode = {
653:           ...node,
654:           frameId,
655:           frameUrl: redactBrowserUrl(context.frame.url),
656:           ...(node.bounds
657:             ? {
658:                 bounds: {
659:                   x: node.bounds.x + context.offsetX,
660:                   y: node.bounds.y + context.offsetY,
661:                   width: node.bounds.width,
662:                   height: node.bounds.height,
663:                 },
664:               }
665:             : {}),
666:         };
667:         nodes.push(adjusted);
668:         frameRefs.set(node.ref, context);
669:       }
670:       if (parsed.text) {
671:         textParts.push(parsed.text);
672:         textLength += parsed.text.length + 1;
673:       }
674:       textTruncated ||= parsed.textTruncated;
675:       nodesTruncated ||= parsed.nodesTruncated;
676:     }
677:     if (record.info.generation !== generation) {
678:       throw new BrowserError("INSPECTION_STALE", "Browser page changed while collecting a snapshot", {
679:         details: { reason: "generation-changed" },
680:       });
681:     }
682:     record.snapshot = {
683:       id: snapshotId,
684:       generation,
685:       refs: new Set(nodes.map((node) => node.ref)),
686:       nodes: new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.ref, node])),
687:       frames: frameRefs,
688:     };
689:     return {
690:       snapshot: {
691:         tabId: record.info.id,
692:         snapshotId,
693:         generation,
694:         url: redactBrowserUrl(record.info.url),
695:         title: record.info.title,
696:         text: textParts.join("\n").slice(0, maxTextChars),
697:         nodes,
698:         truncated: textTruncated || nodesTruncated,
699:         untrustedWebContent: true,
700:       },
701:       truncated: {
702:         text: textTruncated,
703:         nodes: nodesTruncated,
704:       },
705:     };
706:   }

708:   private async captureScreenshot(
709:     record: TabRecord,
710:     options: BrowserScreenshotOptions,
711:   ): Promise<BrowserScreenshotResult> {
712:     const format = options.format ?? "png";
713:     const quality = options.quality ?? 85;
714:     const mode = options.mode ?? "viewport";
715:     const generation = record.info.generation;
716:     if (mode === "element") {
717:       if (!options.snapshotId || !options.ref || options.generation === undefined) {
718:         throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Element screenshot requires a snapshot reference");
719:       }
720:       this.assertSnapshotRef(record, options.ref, options.snapshotId, options.generation);
721:     }
722:     let image: Electron.NativeImage | undefined;
723:     let captureError: unknown;
724:     if (mode !== "full-page") {
725:       const rect =
726:         mode === "element"
727:           ? screenshotRectForNode(record.snapshot?.nodes.get(options.ref!), MAX_SCREENSHOT_PIXELS)
728:           : undefined;
729:       for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt += 1) {
730:         try {
731:           image = await withTimeout(
732:             record.view.webContents.capturePage(rect, { stayHidden: true, stayAwake: true }),
733:             3_000,
734:             "ACTION_TIMEOUT",
735:           );
736:           if (!image.isEmpty()) break;
737:         } catch (error) {
738:           captureError = error;
739:         }
740:         await abortableDelay(100);
741:       }
742:       if (mode === "viewport" && (!image || image.isEmpty())) {
743:         try {
744:           image = await capturePresentedFrame(record.view.webContents, 3_000);
745:         } catch (error) {
746:           captureError = error;
747:         }
748:       }
749:     }
750:     let buffer: Buffer;
751:     let size: Electron.Size;
752:     if (image && !image.isEmpty()) {
753:       size = image.getSize();
754:       buffer = format === "jpeg" ? image.toJPEG(clampInteger(quality, 1, 100)) : image.toPNG();
755:     } else {
756:       const clip = await this.screenshotClip(record, mode, options);
757:       if (clip.width * clip.height > MAX_SCREENSHOT_PIXELS) {
758:         throw new BrowserError("RESULT_TOO_LARGE", "Browser screenshot exceeds the pixel limit");
759:       }
760:       const releaseDebugger = this.cdp.acquire(record.info.id);
761:       try {
762:         const captured = (await withTimeout(
763:           this.cdp.sendCommand(record.info.id, "Page.captureScreenshot", {
764:             format,
765:             ...(format === "jpeg" ? { quality: clampInteger(quality, 1, 100) } : {}),
766:             fromSurface: true,
767:             captureBeyondViewport: mode === "full-page",
768:             clip: { ...clip, scale: 1 },
769:           }),
770:           8_000,
771:           "ACTION_TIMEOUT",
772:         )) as { data?: string };
773:         if (!captured.data) throw captureError ?? new Error("CDP screenshot returned no data");
774:         buffer = Buffer.from(captured.data, "base64");
775:         size = nativeImage.createFromBuffer(buffer).getSize();
776:       } catch (error) {
777:         const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
778:         const nativeReason = captureError instanceof Error ? captureError.message : String(captureError ?? "none");
779:         throw new BrowserError(
780:           "ACTION_TIMEOUT",
781:           `Browser screenshot surface is not ready (${reason}; native=${nativeReason})`,
782:           {
783:             retryable: true,
784:             cause: error,
785:           },
786:         );
787:       } finally {
788:         releaseDebugger();
789:       }
790:     }
791:     if (record.info.generation !== generation) {
792:       throw new BrowserError("INSPECTION_STALE", "Browser page changed during screenshot", {
793:         details: { reason: "generation-changed" },
794:       });
795:     }
796:     if (buffer.byteLength > MAX_SCREENSHOT_BYTES) {
797:       throw new BrowserError("RESULT_TOO_LARGE", "Browser screenshot exceeds the result size limit");
798:     }
799:     return {
800:       tabId: record.info.id,
801:       mime: format === "jpeg" ? "image/jpeg" : "image/png",
802:       base64: buffer.toString("base64"),
803:       width: size.width,
804:       height: size.height,
805:       mode,
806:       generation,
807:       untrustedWebContent: true,
808:     };
809:   }
810: 
811:   private async screenshotClip(
812:     record: TabRecord,
813:     mode: BrowserScreenshotMode,
814:     options: BrowserScreenshotOptions,
815:   ): Promise<{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }> {
816:     if (mode === "element") {
817:       return screenshotRectForNode(record.snapshot?.nodes.get(options.ref!), MAX_SCREENSHOT_PIXELS);
818:     }
819:     if (mode === "full-page") {
820:       const releaseDebugger = this.cdp.acquire(record.info.id);
821:       try {
822:         const metrics = await this.cdp.sendCommand<{
823:           cssContentSize?: { width?: number; height?: number };
824:         }>(record.info.id, "Page.getLayoutMetrics");
825:         const width = clampInteger(Number(metrics.cssContentSize?.width), 1, 8_192);
826:         const rawHeight = Number(metrics.cssContentSize?.height);
827:         if (!Number.isFinite(rawHeight) || rawHeight <= 0 || rawHeight > MAX_FULL_PAGE_HEIGHT) {
828:           throw new BrowserError("RESULT_TOO_LARGE", "Browser full-page screenshot exceeds the height limit");
829:         }
830:         return { x: 0, y: 0, width, height: Math.ceil(rawHeight) };
831:       } finally {
832:         releaseDebugger();
833:       }
834:     }
835:     const viewport = (await record.view.webContents.executeJavaScriptInIsolatedWorld(SNAPSHOT_WORLD_ID, [
836:       { code: "({ width: Math.max(1, innerWidth), height: Math.max(1, innerHeight) })" },
837:     ])) as { width?: unknown; height?: unknown };
838:     return {
839:       x: 0,
840:       y: 0,
841:       width: clampInteger(Number(viewport.width), 1, 8_192),
842:       height: clampInteger(Number(viewport.height), 1, 8_192),
843:     };
844:   }

846:   async click(
847:     tabId: string,
848:     sessionId: string,
849:     ref: string,
850:     snapshotId: string,
851:     generation: number,
852:     button: "left" | "middle" | "right" = "left",
853:     clickCount: 1 | 2 = 1,
854:     modifiers: BrowserInputModifier[] = [],
855:   ): Promise<BrowserClickResult> {
856:     modifiers = validateInputModifiers(modifiers);
857:     if (!["left", "middle", "right"].includes(button) || (clickCount !== 1 && clickCount !== 2)) {
858:       throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser click options are invalid");
859:     }
860:     const record = this.requireOwnedTab(tabId, sessionId);
861:     this.assertSnapshotRef(record, ref, snapshotId, generation);
862:     return this.runAction(record, sessionId, "interact", async (signal) => {
863:       record.pendingFileUpload = undefined;
864:       const node = record.snapshot?.nodes.get(ref);
865:       if (node && isSensitiveNode(node)) {
866:         await this.approveSensitiveAction(record, `Click ${node.name || node.role}`);
867:       }
868:       const frameContext = record.snapshot?.frames.get(ref);
869:       if (!frameContext) throw new BrowserError("STALE_ELEMENT_REF", "Browser frame is no longer available");
870:       const point = await withTimeout(
871:         frameContext.frame.executeJavaScript(elementPointScript(snapshotId, ref, node?.role === "file-upload")),
872:         this.options.getSettings().navigation.actionTimeoutMs,
873:         "ACTION_TIMEOUT",
874:         signal,
875:       );
876:       if (!isPoint(point)) throw new BrowserError("STALE_ELEMENT_REF", "Browser element is no longer actionable");
877:       point.x += frameContext.offsetX;
878:       point.y += frameContext.offsetY;
879:       if (point.externalUrl) {
880:         if (!/^mailto:/i.test(point.externalUrl)) {
881:           throw new BrowserError("UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL", "External Browser protocol is not allowed");
882:         }
883:         await (this.options.openExternal?.(point.externalUrl) ?? Promise.resolve());
884:         return {
885:           ok: true,
886:           action: "external-protocol",
887:           tabId,
888:           url: record.info.url,
889:           generation: record.info.generation,
890:         };
891:       }
892:       const capture: NonNullable<TabRecord["activeClickCapture"]> = {};
893:       record.activeClickCapture = capture;
894:       let sendingSyntheticInput = false;
895:       try {
896:         if (this.options.getSettings().automation.showActionHighlight) {
897:           await frameContext.frame.executeJavaScript(elementHighlightScript(snapshotId, ref, true));
898:           await abortableDelay(120, signal);
899:         }
900:         record.syntheticInput += 1;
901:         sendingSyntheticInput = true;
902:         await this.sendMouseClick(record, point.x, point.y, button, clickCount, signal, modifiers);
903:         // Chromium delivers synthetic mouse events asynchronously. Keep the
904:         // synthetic-input guard through the next task so they cannot be mistaken
905:         // for a local user takeover.
906:         if (node?.role !== "file-upload") await abortableDelay(0, signal);
907:       } finally {
908:         if (!record.view.webContents.isDestroyed()) {
909:           void frameContext.frame
910:             .executeJavaScript(elementHighlightScript(snapshotId, ref, false))
911:             .catch(() => undefined);
912:         }
913:         if (sendingSyntheticInput) record.syntheticInput -= 1;
914:       }
915:       try {
916:         // File inputs hand control to the local upload picker. Return as soon as
917:         // Chromium has focused the input; waiting for navigation would allow the
918:         // native chooser lifecycle to clear that focus before file injection.
919:         if (node?.role === "file-upload") {
920:           record.pendingFileUpload = { snapshotId, ref, generation };
921:           return {
922:             ok: true,
923:             action: "clicked",
924:             tabId,
925:             url: record.info.url,
926:             generation: record.info.generation,
927:           };
928:         }
929:         await abortableDelay(CLICK_NAVIGATION_DETECTION_MS, signal);
930:         const observation = capture.observation;
931:         if (!observation) {
932:           return {
933:             ok: true,
934:             action: "clicked",
935:             tabId,
936:             url: record.info.url,
937:             generation: record.info.generation,
938:           };
939:         }
940:         if (observation.kind === "new-tab") {
941:           const navigation = await observation.result;
942:           return {
943:             ok: true,
944:             action: "clicked",
945:             tabId,
946:             url: record.info.url,
947:             generation: record.info.generation,
948:             navigation,
949:           };
950:         }
951:         await this.waitForLoad(record, this.options.getSettings().navigation.navigationTimeoutMs, signal);
952:         const failure = record.lastLoadFailure ? structuredClone(record.lastLoadFailure) : undefined;
953:         return {
954:           ok: true,
955:           action: "clicked",
956:           tabId,
957:           url: record.info.url,
958:           generation: record.info.generation,
959:           navigation: {
960:             kind: "same-tab",
961:             status: failure ? "failed" : "completed",
962:             tabId,

138: async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(
139:   values: readonly T[],
140:   concurrency: number,
141:   mapper: (value: T, index: number) => Promise<R>,
142: ): Promise<R[]> {
143:   const results = new Array<R>(values.length);
144:   let nextIndex = 0;
145:   const worker = async (): Promise<void> => {
146:     for (;;) {
147:       const index = nextIndex;
148:       nextIndex += 1;
149:       if (index >= values.length) return;
150:       results[index] = await mapper(values[index]!, index);
151:     }
152:   };
153:   await Promise.all(
154:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(Math.max(1, concurrency), Math.max(1, values.length)) }, () => worker()),
155:   );
156:   return results;
157: }

289:   async getPublicStateForProject(cwd: string): Promise<PublicToolchainState> {
290:     const resolution = await this.resolveForProject(cwd, { intent: "project-command", trusted: false });
291:     const state = structuredClone(this.getPublicState());
292:     state.projectSummary = resolution.summary.filter((line) => line.startsWith("Project "));
293:     for (const capability of TOOL_CAPABILITY_IDS) {
294:       const entry = state.capabilities[capability];
295:       if (!entry) continue;
296:       const descriptor = resolution.commands[capability];
297:       if (!descriptor) {
298:         if (entry.health === "healthy") {
299:           entry.provider = undefined;
300:           entry.version = undefined;
301:           entry.pathLabel = undefined;
302:           entry.health = "missing";
303:           entry.reasonCode = missingReasonForCapability(capability);
304:         }
305:         continue;
306:       }
307:       const pathLabel = redactToolPath(descriptor.executable, this.redactionRoots, this.platform);
308:       entry.provider = descriptor.provider;
309:       entry.version = descriptor.version;
310:       entry.pathLabel = pathLabel;
311:       entry.health = "healthy";
312:       entry.reasonCode = undefined;
313:       if (
314:         descriptor.provider === "project" &&
315:         !entry.candidates.some((candidate) => candidate.pathLabel === pathLabel)
316:       ) {
317:         entry.candidates.unshift({
318:           id: `project:${createHash("sha256").update(`${resolution.id}\0${capability}`).digest("hex").slice(0, 20)}`,
319:           capability,
320:           provider: "project",
321:           version: descriptor.version,
322:           pathLabel,
323:           health: "healthy",
324:         });
325:       }
326:     }

330:   async performAction(request: ToolchainActionRequest): Promise<PublicToolchainState> {
331:     switch (request.action) {
332:       case "rescan":

334:       case "install-component":
335:       case "repair-component":
336:         return this.installComponent(request.componentId);
337:       case "cancel-component-install":
338:         return this.cancelComponentInstall(request.componentId);
339:       case "install-profile": {
340:         const components = PROFILE_COMPONENTS[request.profileId] ?? [];
341:         for (const componentId of components) await this.installComponent(componentId);
342:         return this.getPublicState();
343:       }
344:       case "set-preference":
345:         if (!this.stateStore) {
346:           throw new ToolchainError({ code: "TOOLCHAIN_INTERNAL", message: "Toolchain state store is unavailable" });
347:         }
348:         this.persistentState = this.stateStore.update((draft) => {
349:           draft.preferences[request.capability] = { mode: request.preference };
350:         });
351:         this.preferences[request.capability] = request.preference;
352:         return (await this.rescan()).publicState;
353:       case "choose-custom-tool":
354:         throw new ToolchainError({

358:       case "clear-cache":

362:       case "remove-component":
363:         await this.removeComponent(request.componentId);

376:   async registerCustomTool(capability: ToolCapabilityId, executable: string): Promise<PublicToolchainState> {
377:     if (!this.stateStore) {
378:       throw new ToolchainError({ code: "TOOLCHAIN_INTERNAL", message: "Toolchain state store is unavailable" });
379:     }
380:     const pathApi = this.platform === "win32" ? path.win32 : path.posix;
381:     const normalized = normalizeToolPath(executable, this.platform);
382:     if (
383:       !normalized ||
384:       normalized.length > 4_096 ||
385:       /[\0\r\n]/.test(normalized) ||
386:       !pathApi.isAbsolute(normalized) ||
387:       !this.fileSystem.isFile(normalized)
388:     ) {
389:       throw new ToolchainError({
390:         code: "TOOLCHAIN_INVALID_SELECTION",
391:         capability,
392:         message: "The selected tool is not an absolute executable file",
393:       });
394:     }
395: 
396:     const seedCapability = canonicalCustomCapability(capability);
397:     const seed: ExecutableSeed = {
398:       capability: seedCapability,
399:       provider: "custom",
400:       discovery: "user-selected",
401:       executable: normalized,
402:       argvPrefix: [],
403:       binDir: pathApi.dirname(normalized),
404:       rank: 0,
405:     };
406:     let candidates: ToolCandidate[];
407:     try {
408:       candidates = await this.probe(seed, {
409:         platform: this.platform,
410:         arch: this.arch,
411:         env: this.env,
412:         tempRoot: this.tempRoot,
413:         fileSystem: this.fileSystem,
414:         executor: this.executor,
415:       });
416:     } catch (error) {
417:       throw new ToolchainError({
418:         code: "TOOLCHAIN_INVALID_SELECTION",
419:         capability,
420:         message: "The selected executable could not be verified",
421:         cause: error,
422:       });
423:     }
424:     if (!candidates.some((candidate) => candidate.capability === capability && candidate.health === "healthy")) {
425:       throw new ToolchainError({
426:         code: "TOOLCHAIN_INVALID_SELECTION",
427:         capability,
428:         message: "The selected executable does not provide the requested healthy capability",
429:       });
430:     }
431: 
432:     this.persistentState = this.stateStore.update((draft) => {
433:       draft.custom[seedCapability] = { executable: normalized };
434:       for (const candidate of candidates) {
435:         if (candidate.health === "healthy") draft.preferences[candidate.capability] = { mode: "custom" };
436:       }
437:     });
438:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
439:       if (candidate.health === "healthy") this.preferences[candidate.capability] = "custom";
440:     }
441:     return (await this.rescan()).publicState;
442:   }

449:   private installComponent(componentId: ManagedComponentId): Promise<PublicToolchainState> {
450:     const active = this.installs.get(componentId);
451:     if (active) return active;
452:     if (!this.installer || !this.catalog) {
453:       return Promise.reject(
454:         new ToolchainError({
455:           code: "TOOLCHAIN_INVALID_CATALOG",
456:           message: `Managed ${componentId} is unavailable in this application build`,
457:         }),
458:       );
459:     }
460:     const operationId = randomUUID();
461:     const controller = new AbortController();
462:     this.installControllers.set(componentId, controller);
463:     this.operations.set(operationId, { operationId, componentId, phase: "queued" });
464:     this.refreshPublicState();
465:     const install = this.installer
466:       .install(componentId, (progress) => this.updateOperation(operationId, componentId, progress), controller.signal)
467:       .then(async (state) => {
468:         this.persistentState = state;
469:         return (await this.rescan()).publicState;
470:       })
471:       .finally(() => {
472:         this.installs.delete(componentId);
473:         this.installControllers.delete(componentId);
474:       });
475:     this.installs.set(componentId, install);
476:     return install;
477:   }

479:   private async cancelComponentInstall(componentId: ManagedComponentId): Promise<PublicToolchainState> {
480:     const controller = this.installControllers.get(componentId);

482:     if (!controller || !install) return this.getPublicState();
483:     controller.abort();
484:     try {
485:       await install;
486:     } catch (error) {
487:       if (!(error instanceof ToolchainError) || error.code !== "TOOLCHAIN_CANCELLED") throw error;
488:     }
489:     return this.getPublicState();
490:   }

500:     fs.mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
501:     for (const name of fs.readdirSync(directory)) {

506:   private async removeComponent(componentId: ManagedComponentId): Promise<void> {
507:     if (!this.paths || !this.stateStore) {
508:       throw new ToolchainError({ code: "TOOLCHAIN_INTERNAL", message: "Managed runtimes are unavailable" });
509:     }
510:     if (this.installs.has(componentId)) {
511:       throw new ToolchainError({
512:         code: "TOOLCHAIN_INSTALL_BUSY",
513:         message: `${componentId} is currently being installed`,
514:       });
515:     }
516:     if (this.isRuntimeInUse()) {
517:       throw new ToolchainError({
518:         code: "TOOLCHAIN_INSTALL_BUSY",
519:         message: `Managed ${componentId} cannot be removed while an Agent command is running`,
520:       });
521:     }
522:     const componentRoot = path.join(this.paths.runtimes, componentId);
523:     let trashPath: string | undefined;
524:     if (fs.existsSync(componentRoot)) {
525:       fs.mkdirSync(this.paths.staging, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
526:       trashPath = path.join(this.paths.staging, `remove-${componentId}-${randomUUID()}`);
527:       try {
528:         fs.renameSync(componentRoot, trashPath);
529:       } catch (error) {
530:         throw new ToolchainError({
531:           code: "TOOLCHAIN_PERMISSION_DENIED",
532:           message: `Managed ${componentId} is still in use or cannot be removed`,
533:           cause: error,
534:         });
535:       }
536:     }
537:     try {
538:       this.persistentState = this.stateStore.update((draft) => {
539:         delete draft.managed[componentId];
540:       });
541:     } catch (error) {
542:       if (trashPath && fs.existsSync(trashPath)) fs.renameSync(trashPath, componentRoot);
543:       throw error;
544:     }
545:     if (trashPath) fs.rmSync(trashPath, { recursive: true, force: true });
546:   }

548:   private pruneManagedVersionsAtStartup(): void {
549:     if (!this.paths || !this.stateStore) return;
550:     const removals: Array<{ componentId: ManagedComponentId; version: string; runtimeRoot: string }> = [];
551:     const retainedByComponent = new Map<ManagedComponentId, string[]>();
552:     for (const [componentId, activation] of Object.entries(this.persistentState.managed) as Array<
553:       [ManagedComponentId, NonNullable<ToolchainPersistentState["managed"][ManagedComponentId]>]
554:     >) {
555:       if (!activation) continue;
556:       if (activation.platformArch !== `${this.platform}-${this.arch}`) continue;
557:       const versions = [...new Set([...activation.installedVersions, activation.activeVersion])];
558:       const retained = retainedManagedVersions(componentId, activation.activeVersion, versions);
559:       retainedByComponent.set(componentId, retained);
560:       for (const version of versions) {
561:         if (retained.includes(version)) continue;
562:         removals.push({
563:           componentId,
564:           version,
565:           runtimeRoot: runtimeDirectory(this.paths, componentId, version, this.platform, this.arch),
566:         });
567:       }
568:     }
569:     if (removals.length === 0) return;
570: 
571:     fs.mkdirSync(this.paths.staging, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
572:     const moved: Array<{ original: string; staged: string }> = [];
573:     try {
574:       for (const removal of removals) {
575:         if (!fs.existsSync(removal.runtimeRoot)) continue;
576:         const staged = path.join(
577:           this.paths.staging,
578:           `prune-${removal.componentId}-${createHash("sha256").update(removal.version).digest("hex").slice(0, 12)}-${randomUUID()}`,
579:         );
580:         fs.renameSync(removal.runtimeRoot, staged);
581:         moved.push({ original: removal.runtimeRoot, staged });
582:       }
583:       this.persistentState = this.stateStore.update((draft) => {
584:         for (const [componentId, versions] of retainedByComponent) {
585:           const activation = draft.managed[componentId];
586:           if (activation) activation.installedVersions = versions;
587:         }
588:       });
589:       for (const entry of moved) fs.rmSync(entry.staged, { recursive: true, force: true });
590:     } catch {
591:       for (const entry of moved.reverse()) {
592:         try {
593:           if (!fs.existsSync(entry.original) && fs.existsSync(entry.staged))
594:             fs.renameSync(entry.staged, entry.original);
595:         } catch {
596:           // A failed startup cleanup must not prevent discovery of the active runtime.
597:         }
598:       }
599:     }
600:   }

602:   async resolveForProject(cwd: string, options: ResolveProjectOptions = {}): Promise<ToolchainResolution> {
603:     if (!path.isAbsolute(cwd) || cwd.length > 4_096 || /[\0\r\n]/.test(cwd)) {
604:       throw new Error("Invalid toolchain workspace path");
605:     }
606:     const normalizedCwd = path.normalize(cwd);
607:     const intent = options.intent ?? "project-command";
608:     const trusted = options.trusted === true;
609:     const detected = detectProjectTools(normalizedCwd, {
610:       trusted,
611:       platform: this.platform,
612:       env: this.env,
613:     });
614:     const workspaceKey = createHash("sha256").update(normalizedCwd).digest("hex").slice(0, 24);
615:     const requirementsHash = createHash("sha256")
616:       .update(detected.fingerprint)
617:       .update("\0")
618:       .update(intent)
619:       .digest("hex")
620:       .slice(0, 24);
621:     const cacheKey = `${this.snapshot.revision}:${workspaceKey}:${requirementsHash}`;
622:     const cached = this.resolutionCache.get(cacheKey);
623:     if (cached) return cached;
624:     const commands = await this.resolveCommands(detected, intent);
625:     const summary = [...summarizeCommands(commands), ...summarizeRequirements(detected.requirements, commands)];
626:     const resolution: ToolchainResolution = {
627:       id: `r${this.snapshot.revision}-${workspaceKey}-${requirementsHash}`,
628:       inventoryRevision: this.snapshot.revision,
629:       workspaceKey,
630:       requirementsHash,
631:       commands,
632:       summary,
633:     };
634:     this.resolutionCache.set(cacheKey, resolution);
635:     return resolution;
636:   }

638:   private async resolveCommands(
639:     detected: DetectedProjectTools,
640:     intent: ExecutionIntent,
641:   ): Promise<ToolchainResolution["commands"]> {
642:     const commands = Object.fromEntries(
643:       Object.entries(this.snapshot.defaults).map(([capability, descriptor]) => [
644:         capability,
645:         descriptor
646:           ? {
647:               ...descriptor,
648:               argvPrefix: [...descriptor.argvPrefix],
649:               pathEntries: descriptor.pathEntries ? [...descriptor.pathEntries] : undefined,
650:               shellPathEntries: descriptor.shellPathEntries ? [...descriptor.shellPathEntries] : undefined,
651:               envPatch: { ...descriptor.envPatch },
652:               shellEnvPatch: descriptor.shellEnvPatch ? { ...descriptor.shellEnvPatch } : undefined,
653:             }
654:           : descriptor,
655:       ]),
656:     ) as ToolchainResolution["commands"];
657:     const projectAware = intent === "agent-shell" || intent === "python-script" || intent === "project-command";
658:     this.resolveNodeCommands(commands, projectAware ? detected.requirements.nodeRange : undefined, intent);
659:     await this.resolvePythonCommands(commands, detected, projectAware);
660:     return commands;
661:   }

663:   private resolveNodeCommands(
664:     commands: ToolchainResolution["commands"],
665:     request: string | undefined,
666:     intent: ExecutionIntent,
667:   ): void {
668:     const legacyNpm =
669:       intent === "plugin-install" && ["auto", "custom"].includes(this.preferences["js.npm"] ?? "auto")
670:         ? this.snapshot.candidates.find(
671:             (candidate) =>
672:               candidate.capability === "js.npm" &&
673:               candidate.provider === "custom" &&
674:               candidate.discovery === "legacy-npm-command" &&
675:               candidate.health === "healthy",
676:           )
677:         : undefined;
678:     const node = this.selectCandidate("js.node", (candidate) => nodeVersionSatisfies(candidate.version, request));
679:     if (!node) {
680:       delete commands["js.node"];
681:       delete commands["js.npm"];
682:       delete commands["js.npx"];
683:       if (legacyNpm) commands["js.npm"] = this.descriptor(legacyNpm);
684:       return;
685:     }
686:     commands["js.node"] = this.descriptor(node);
687:     for (const capability of ["js.npm", "js.npx"] as const) {
688:       const paired = this.selectCandidate(capability, (candidate) => sameComponent(node, candidate, this.platform));
689:       if (paired) commands[capability] = this.descriptor(paired);
690:       else delete commands[capability];
691:     }
692:     if (legacyNpm) commands["js.npm"] = this.descriptor(legacyNpm);
693:   }
694: 
695:   private async resolvePythonCommands(
696:     commands: ToolchainResolution["commands"],
697:     detected: DetectedProjectTools,
698:     projectAware: boolean,
699:   ): Promise<void> {
700:     let python: ToolCandidate | undefined;
701:     if (
702:       projectAware &&
703:       detected.requirements.trusted &&
704:       detected.pythonExecutable &&
705:       detected.requirements.pythonEnvironment
706:     ) {
707:       python = await this.probeProjectPython(detected);

25:   promise: Promise<void>;

31: export interface BrowserAuthorizationCoordinatorOptions {
32:   getPersistentPermission: (sessionId: string) => Exclude<BrowserPersistentSessionPermission, "inherit">;
33:   isRendererAvailable: () => boolean;
34:   grant: (
35:     sessionId: string,
36:     permission: RequiredPermission,
37:     source: "local" | "channel",
38:     grantSource: "user-prompt" | "persistent-policy",

40:   emitRequest: (request: BrowserAgentAuthorizationRequest) => void;
41:   emitResolved: (requestId: string, outcome: ResolveOutcome) => void;
42:   now?: () => number;

49: export class BrowserAuthorizationCoordinator {
50:   private readonly pendingBySession = new Map<string, Pending>();
51:   private readonly pendingById = new Map<string, Pending>();
52:   private readonly queue: Pending[] = [];
53:   private active: Pending | null = null;
54:   private readonly deniedUntil = new Map<string, number>();
55:   private readonly now: () => number;
56:   private readonly createId: () => string;
57:   private readonly timeoutMs: number;
58:   private readonly denyCooldownMs: number;
59:   private readonly maxDeniedCooldowns: number;
60:   private readonly options: BrowserAuthorizationCoordinatorOptions;
61: 
62:   constructor(options: BrowserAuthorizationCoordinatorOptions) {
63:     this.options = options;
64:     this.now = options.now ?? Date.now;
65:     this.createId = options.createId ?? randomUUID;
66:     this.timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 60_000;
67:     this.denyCooldownMs = options.denyCooldownMs ?? 2_000;
68:     this.maxDeniedCooldowns = Math.max(1, options.maxDeniedCooldowns ?? DEFAULT_MAX_DENIED_COOLDOWNS);
69:   }
70: 
71:   async request(sessionId: string, source: "local" | "channel", minimumPermission: RequiredPermission): Promise<void> {
72:     const persistent = this.options.getPersistentPermission(sessionId);
73:     if (persistent === "deny") {
74:       throw new BrowserError("USER_DENIED", "Browser access is denied by the persistent policy");
75:     }
76:     if (RANK[persistent] >= RANK[minimumPermission]) {
77:       this.options.grant(sessionId, minimumPermission, source, "persistent-policy");
78:       return;
79:     }
80:     const now = this.now();
81:     this.pruneDeniedUntil(now);
82:     if ((this.deniedUntil.get(sessionId) ?? 0) > now) {
83:       throw new BrowserError("USER_DENIED", "Browser access was recently denied");
84:     }
85:     if (!this.options.isRendererAvailable()) {
86:       throw new BrowserError("CAPABILITY_DISABLED", "The local authorization UI is unavailable");
87:     }
88: 
89:     const existing = this.pendingBySession.get(sessionId);
90:     if (existing) {
91:       if (RANK[existing.request.minimumPermission] >= RANK[minimumPermission]) {
92:         await existing.promise;
93:         return;
94:       }
95:       try {
96:         await existing.promise;
97:       } catch {
98:         // A higher-tier request is independently evaluated after the current
99:         // dialog resolves; it never stacks a second dialog.
100:       }
101:       return this.request(sessionId, source, minimumPermission);
102:     }
103: 
104:     const createdAt = this.now();
105:     const request: BrowserAgentAuthorizationRequest = {
106:       id: this.createId(),
107:       sessionId,
108:       source,
109:       methodCategory: minimumPermission,
110:       minimumPermission,
111:       createdAt,
112:       expiresAt: createdAt + this.timeoutMs,
113:     };
114:     let resolvePromise!: () => void;
115:     let rejectPromise!: (error: Error) => void;
116:     const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
117:       resolvePromise = resolve;
118:       rejectPromise = reject;
119:     });
120:     const pending: Pending = {
121:       request,
122:       promise,
123:       resolve: resolvePromise,
124:       reject: rejectPromise,
125:       timer: setTimeout(() => {
126:         this.finish(pending, "timeout", new BrowserError("AUTHORIZATION_TIMEOUT", "Browser authorization timed out"));
127:       }, this.timeoutMs),
128:     };
129:     this.pendingBySession.set(sessionId, pending);
130:     this.pendingById.set(request.id, pending);
131:     if (this.active) this.queue.push(pending);
132:     else this.activate(pending);

134:   }
135: 
136:   respond(requestId: string, decision: BrowserAgentAuthorizationDecision): void {
137:     if (decision !== "deny" && decision !== "allow-session") {
138:       throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser authorization decision is invalid");
139:     }
140:     const pending = this.pendingById.get(requestId);
141:     if (!pending || pending.request.expiresAt <= this.now()) {
142:       throw new BrowserError("INVALID_BROWSER_REQUEST", "Browser authorization request is stale");
143:     }
144:     if (decision === "deny") {
145:       this.recordDenial(pending.request.sessionId);
146:       this.finish(pending, "denied", new BrowserError("USER_DENIED", "The user denied Browser access"));
147:       return;
148:     }
149:     this.grantAndFinish(pending, "user-prompt", "allowed-session");
150:   }
151: 
152:   persistentPolicyChanged(sessionId: string): void {
153:     const pending = this.pendingBySession.get(sessionId);
154:     if (!pending) return;
155:     const permission = this.options.getPersistentPermission(sessionId);
156:     if (permission === "deny") {
157:       this.finish(pending, "denied", new BrowserError("USER_DENIED", "Browser access is denied by settings"));
158:       return;
159:     }
160:     if (RANK[permission] >= RANK[pending.request.minimumPermission]) {
161:       this.grantAndFinish(pending, "persistent-policy", "persistent-policy");
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   cancelSession(sessionId: string): void {
166:     const pending = this.pendingBySession.get(sessionId);
167:     if (pending) {
168:       this.finish(pending, "cancelled", new BrowserError("CAPABILITY_DISABLED", "Browser authorization was cancelled"));
169:     }
170:     this.deniedUntil.delete(sessionId);
171:   }
172: 
173:   cancelAll(): void {
174:     const active = this.active;
175:     for (const pending of [...this.pendingById.values()].filter((candidate) => candidate !== active)) {
176:       this.finish(pending, "cancelled", new BrowserError("CAPABILITY_DISABLED", "Browser authorization was cancelled"));
177:     }
178:     if (active) {
179:       this.finish(active, "cancelled", new BrowserError("CAPABILITY_DISABLED", "Browser authorization was cancelled"));
180:     }
181:     this.deniedUntil.clear();
182:   }
183: 
184:   listPending(): BrowserAgentAuthorizationRequest[] {
185:     return [...this.pendingById.values()].map(({ request }) => structuredClone(request));
186:   }
187: 
188:   private finish(pending: Pending, outcome: ResolveOutcome, error?: Error): void {
189:     if (!this.pendingById.has(pending.request.id)) return;
190:     clearTimeout(pending.timer);
191:     this.pendingById.delete(pending.request.id);
192:     const queueIndex = this.queue.indexOf(pending);
193:     if (queueIndex >= 0) this.queue.splice(queueIndex, 1);
194:     if (this.pendingBySession.get(pending.request.sessionId) === pending) {
195:       this.pendingBySession.delete(pending.request.sessionId);
196:     }
197:     if (this.active === pending) this.active = null;
198:     this.options.emitResolved(pending.request.id, outcome);
199:     if (error) pending.reject(error);
200:     else pending.resolve();
201:     if (!this.active) {
202:       const next = this.queue.shift();
203:       if (next && this.pendingById.has(next.request.id)) this.activate(next);
204:     }
205:   }
206: 
207:   private grantAndFinish(
208:     pending: Pending,
209:     grantSource: "user-prompt" | "persistent-policy",
210:     outcome: "allowed-session" | "persistent-policy",
211:   ): void {
212:     try {
213:       this.options.grant(
214:         pending.request.sessionId,
215:         pending.request.minimumPermission,
216:         pending.request.source,
217:         grantSource,
218:       );
219:     } catch (error) {
220:       const failure =
221:         error instanceof Error
222:           ? error
223:           : new BrowserError("CAPABILITY_DISABLED", "Browser authorization grant failed", { cause: error });
224:       this.finish(pending, "denied", failure);
225:       throw failure;
226:     }
227:     this.finish(pending, outcome);
228:   }
229: 
230:   private activate(pending: Pending): void {
231:     this.active = pending;
232:     this.options.emitRequest(structuredClone(pending.request));
233:   }
234: 
235:   private recordDenial(sessionId: string): void {
236:     const now = this.now();
237:     this.pruneDeniedUntil(now);
238:     this.deniedUntil.delete(sessionId);
239:     while (this.deniedUntil.size >= this.maxDeniedCooldowns) {
240:       const oldestSessionId = this.deniedUntil.keys().next().value as string | undefined;
241:       if (oldestSessionId === undefined) break;
242:       this.deniedUntil.delete(oldestSessionId);
243:     }
244:     this.deniedUntil.set(sessionId, now + this.denyCooldownMs);
245:   }
246: 
247:   private pruneDeniedUntil(now: number): void {
248:     for (const [sessionId, expiresAt] of this.deniedUntil) {
249:       if (expiresAt <= now) this.deniedUntil.delete(sessionId);
250:     }
251:   }
